Initial release — expert advisor for multi-agent AI framework selection and architecture.

- Compares top orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Strands Agents) based on the latest 2026 ecosystem.
- Analyzes user requirements and generates tailored framework comparisons, architecture diagrams, and starter Python scaffolds.
